name: zanker-reference-curation
description: Maintain trustworthy, attributable JSON knowledge without scraping proprietary courses.

workflow.instruction: Locate the official primary reference and read applicable scope.
Write concise original operational rule with source URL, limitations, antipattern and acceptance.
Add record to relevant JSON pack, update index and run `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/validate.sh`.
Do not copy paid courses or protected third-party source into redistributed package.

fallback: Mark source as unverified and omit hard requirements until checked.
